defect: Daily [RoofOps] 07 run failed on a Google Drive rate limit and lost the rest of the run

diagnosis.failed_node: Drive Folders To Read threw "Drive root not found exactly once (HTTP 403, 0 roots)" on the Find Drive Root answer
diagnosis.classification: A true per-minute rate limit on the OAuth client's Google Cloud project (usageLimits / rateLimitExceeded), not a permission or credential problem despite the PERMISSION_DENIED status text. The run makes one Drive search, so the 12,000/min budget is consumed by others using the same OAuth client project (most likely a shared client), at the top of the hour; ad-hoc runs at other times verify Drive 3/3. The project owner cannot be confirmed from here.
diagnosis.lost_work: Airtable had reconciled all 6 tables (0 drift) before Drive; Xero check, webhook supervision and wf_reconcile_finish never ran; the run stayed RUNNING until superseded.

changes: Find Drive Root: continue on error (network errors reach the decision)
Decide Drive Answer -> wf_drive_call_decision(status, headers, body, attempt)
Drive Answer: ok -> folder checks; retry -> Wait Before Drive Retry -> Find Drive Root; fail -> Record Drive Unavailable -> Xero
Drive Folders To Read takes the root from the decision (no throw)
Record Drive Findings passes Google's error reason for each folder read

policy.wait: Retry-After (seconds or HTTP date) when present, else 15 s * 2^(attempt-1) + 0..15 s jitter; capped 120 s

offline_tests: test/reconcile-drive-resilience.test.ts: 6 tests x PGlite + Postgres 17; ablations A-F each red on their own test

live_verification.note: The live Google account was not rate-limited on purpose; failure paths are proven offline. One controlled 07 run verified the new success path.
live_verification.drive_health: {"check": "reconciliation RECON-20261001-092703-2e71", "drift": 0, "verified": 3} (recorded by the new success path; 07 never recorded Drive health before)

recommendation: Owner decision, not changed: give the "RoofOps Google Drive" credential its own Google Cloud OAuth client (own per-minute quota), and/or move the daily schedule off the top of the hour.
